strategies.name: fair_value_gap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the trend after a fair value gap that caused a break of structure forms. Mark the gap between the first candle's close and the third candle's open, preferably the FVG closest to an order block, then wait for price to retrace into that FVG and enter for continuation.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap itself—below the FVG for buys and above the FVG for sells. No concrete profit target is taught; the management taught is to wait for price to continue in the trend direction after the tap into the FVG.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to tap back into the bullish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: price will most likely come back mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to return to the bearish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

result.enumeration_note: One strategy is taught: FVG trend-continuation entries in bullish and bearish forms. These are direction variants of the same skeleton, with the same retest entry and stop-placement logic; no separate opposing reversal setup with its own runnable exit is taught.
